reason: A better isolates a single intervention, uses identically processed controls, tests both high-temperature strength and creep, and provides clearer compositional limits and falsification thresholds. B confounds Al addition with a separate aging treatment and compares against an unaged control, making any improvement causally ambiguous; both proposals nonetheless need to verify that the Ti-rich alloy can sustain an FCC matrix and an L1₂ Ni3(Al,Ti)-type phase rather than NiTi/Ni3Ti or other brittle intermetallics.
